blurb: We look forward to welcoming you to your new home in Wikiup. With a great school district, as well as Yorkborough Park, Pelican Ponds Open Space, and City of the Dead Haunted House nearby, you can be confident that this is a great place to raise your family. Located just 11 miles from Denver, you will find a variety of activities to fulfill all of your needs.
